basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.label: First-year PhD candidate at HKUST NLP Group
basics.summary: First-year PhD candidate at HKUST NLP Group, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, supervised by Professor Junxian He. Research focuses on natural language processing and machine learning. Graduated from Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) in June 2024.

education.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
